description: This file defines the CreateValue class within the Minilang framework, implementing the <create-value> element for creating or storing GenericValue entities based on XML element attributes. It includes validation, execution logic, and a factory for instantiation.

classes.name: CreateValue
classes.description: Represents the <create-value> element operation, capable of creating or storing a GenericValue entity based on provided XML attributes.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CreateValue object, performing validation of attributes and setting operation parameters.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the create or store operation for the specified GenericValue in the given method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the create-value element with its attributes.
